verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for an online filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API or machine interface: OpenAPI, llms.txt and markdown probes all return 404, formation runs through fillable PDFs submitted by upload, fax or mail, and the only mandatory-online filing sits behind an image CAPTCHA anti-bot gate. With no evidence of any headless or CI-capable path, the verdict is none.
